content:
The evidence is now clear. E20 shows 503 errors continuing right up to t=590, well after the rollback at t=530 (E11). E21 confirms no successful captures since t=530, with 123 failed payments all starting at t=528. The rollback had no effect on the failures — the provider was already down before the rollback and remains down. No further investigation needed.
